'''Esteve Tomas Roca'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Tomas|Roca}} (born 25 March 1957) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed in the [[Alpine skiing at the 1976 Winter Olympics – Men's giant slalom|men's giant slalom]] at the [[1976 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/to/esteve-tomas-1.html |title=Esteve Tomas |accessdate=18 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418073752/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/to/esteve-tomas-1.html |archive-date=18 April 2020 |quote=Full name: Esteve Tomas Roca}}</ref>
